reviews.text: The service was fantastic! We went in with a lot of questions about how to care for our dog, and they were incredibly helpful. We left her at the groomer's, and they treated her very well. We'll be back!

My puppy's first bath was an exceptional experience. Chata came out looking absolutely beautiful and calm. They were incredibly kind, very patient, and truly professional. You can tell they love their work. Highly recommended. Thank you, Victor!

Wonderful grooming salon. They were very kind to my dog, who is terrified of nail trimming, and they even found a slot for us today despite it being the busy season. Highly recommend!

I've taken my little KEO there and it never disappoints. For me, it's the best dog groomer. My dog ​​has been going for about two years and I'm always happy with the results, and he always leaves happy too... they're great!

Taking our Toy Poodle puppy, Cora, to this groomer recommended by a friend was a great decision. There were three things we really appreciated:

1) Víctor was wonderful. He scheduled an appointment first to get to know us and our puppy better, so she would be more relaxed the next time (the day of her haircut). Cora was absolutely delighted with him, both that first time and again on the day of her haircut.

2) When they finished cutting her hair, we received a WhatsApp message letting us know we could pick her up, along with photos so we could see how she looked. This was a lovely touch, and Cora looked beautiful, just as we had asked Víctor to.

3) We'd like to thank Víctor for the advice he gave us on managing certain behaviors of our puppy. They were very much appreciated, as we're new to this and he didn't need to spend all that time on it once his work was already done.

In short, we'll definitely be back, and we wholeheartedly recommend this center to everyone.

It took me four years to find a professional like Víctor. His respect and love for animals is impressive, and his advice is wise.

His work is spectacular.

My dog isn’t the easiest. She is anxious, barks a lot and has a skin allergy (that’s why she has brown feet). Luckily none of this is a problem at Aratinga. I give them her special shampoo and they do the rest. After the first appointment they immediately remembered everything about her. I also love that they have a big window on the outside so you can see all dogs are treated wonderfully. €45 for 2 hours is a great price! I’ll definitely keep coming back here 🤩
